content.text: {"headline":"Approve P3: all levers plus overtime lifts the 14:45–18:45 service level to 81.2%, the only plan that reaches the 80% target, for ₹5,784.","why":"Payments demand is running well above forecast (+72% at 09:15, 112 vs 65 calls), most likely driven by the 08:35 UPI cashback push MKT-2026-409 (medium confidence). Without action the window is predicted at 69.6% (payments 61.0%) with 7.8% abandons. P3 combines overtime for 7 payments agents (15:15–16:15 and 17:00–18:00), 20% chat deflection of status and refund enquiries, cancelled coaching, delayed breaks and cross-skilled moves. Together these bring the window to 81.2% (payments 77.7%) and cut abandons to 5.1%. It has no policy violations. Rest of day is predicted at 79.7%.","trade_offs":["Cost: P3 costs ₹5,784, ₹2,520 more than P2 (₹3,264). P2 reaches only 78.7%, short of the 80% target, with 6.1% abandons versus 5.1%.","The no-cost plan P1 reaches only 71.7% (payments 64.0%), barely better than doing nothing.","General queue risk is low: it holds at 87.8% under P3 even after the agent moves, versus 87.0% with no action.","Payments itself stays below 80% at 77.7%. The overall target is met because general is strong.","P3 uses the remaining overtime budget, leaving no overtime headroom if demand rises further."],"watch":"Check overtime uptake (7 agents needed per slot) and whether chat deflection is actually taking 20% of status and refund enquiries. Also watch whether payments volume keeps climbing beyond the campaign estimate; if it does, there is no overtime left and the duty manager may need to be involved."}
